name: trading
description: Voice agent for a retail brokerage: quotes, positions, activity and fees, and the four things it must never be allowed to do.

inbound.instructions: In their latest turn, the caller refers to information that is not public: something they heard from an insider, or an event before it is announced
In their latest turn, the caller is instructing a trade: buying, selling, liquidating or cancelling an order
In their latest turn, the caller is reading out an account number, a social security number or a password
In their latest turn, the caller asks for leverage, margin, options or a concentration of risk that may not suit their account
In their latest turn, the caller describes serious losses, threatens a complaint, or names a regulator or a lawyer
In their latest turn, the caller asks to speak with a person rather than an automated agent
In their latest turn, what the caller needs from this turn

criteria.quote: The current price of a named security
criteria.position: Their holdings, balance or buying power
criteria.activity: Recent trades or the status of an order
criteria.simple: A short factual answer about their account or a term
criteria.complex: An explanation, a comparison, or several steps

guard.instructions: The reply recommends buying, selling or holding a security
The reply predicts a price move or promises a return
The reply states a specific price or figure that did not come from a tool result

rules.why: no order is taken when the market is closed, whatever the model thinks
no live desk outside market hours, offer a callback
no live desk outside market hours, offer a callback

scripts.quote: I can read you the last traded price from the market data feed. Which symbol?
scripts.position: I can send your current positions and buying power to the number on the account. Shall I?
scripts.activity: I can text you your last five trades with their status. Would that help?
scripts.fees: Your commission schedule is on the statements page, and I can text you the link now.
scripts.order_to_human: I am not able to take an order myself. Let me put you through to a licensed representative who can.
scripts.halt_compliance: I need to stop you there. I am not able to discuss information that is not public. I am handing this to our compliance desk.
scripts.secure_channel: Please do not read that out. I will send a secure link so you can enter it yourself.
scripts.suitability_review: That one needs a suitability review with a licensed representative before I can go further.
scripts.escalate_advisor: I want to get this to a person who can look at your account properly. Let me connect you.
scripts.transfer: Of course, let me connect you with someone now.
scripts.callback: The desk is closed right now. I can book a callback for when it opens. Would that work?
scripts.market_closed_order: The market is closed, so no order can be placed right now. I can have a representative call you when it opens.
scripts.hold: One moment while I check that for you.
scripts.safe_fallback: Let me get the right person to confirm that for you.

small_llm: That settles two business days after the trade date, so it would be available Thursday.
Yes, you can change that in the app under Account, or I can send you the link.
That symbol is listed on the Nasdaq and trades during regular market hours.
large_llm: There are two things going on there, so let me take them one at a time.
The difference comes down to how each account is taxed, and I can walk you through both.
That charge is a regulatory fee rather than our commission, and here is how it is calculated.

risky_drafts: Honestly at this level I would buy more, it is a good time to add.
Don't worry, it will bounce back, these things always recover.
It is trading at $182.40 right now, so you are up nicely.
